summary: Regression testing completed after the OTP datetime and CORS configuration changes. All existing backend tests and the focused desktop UI workflow passed; valid member OTP now returns 200 and sets a cookie.

minor.issue: A credentialed preflight from the configured public origin returned 400 Disallowed CORS origin, although direct credentialed login and browser UI requests succeeded. Verify the deployed origin/proxy forwards the exact configured Origin consistently.

action_items: Investigate why the public OPTIONS preflight is rejected while direct credentialed requests succeed; confirm FRONTEND_URL/CORS_ORIGINS values at the running backend and proxy.
critical_code_review_comments: No new critical code issues identified. Mocked/development integrations remain intentionally disabled: WhatsApp sending, object storage, and OTP delivery.
seed_data_creation: Existing seeded data and prior TEST records were used; no new records were created by this iteration's focused live checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run the OPTIONS preflight from the exact browser frontend origin, then repeat OTP and cookie checks. Core admin login/dashboard, member search, plan creation, member portal, logout, and four backend regression tests passed.
rca of the issue: The running API responds 400 to an OPTIONS request carrying Origin=https://gym-saas-portal-2.preview.emergentagent.com and requested content-type, indicating the middleware's effective allow_origins does not match that value at the preflight layer. Direct POST requests still return credential headers, so the discrepancy may be deployment/proxy Origin handling or stale runtime environment rather than route logic.
